student_learning_goal: I can find the mode of a data set.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find the mode of a data set.
header.character_watermark: Tally with a clipboard pointing at a graph in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: 4 small displays stacked: tally, pictograph, bar graph, line plot.

image_placeholders.description: 4 small data displays for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Display 1: tally chart (apples 5, bananas 3, grapes 2). Display 2: pictograph (dogs 4, cats 6, fish 1). Display 3: bar graph (sports). Display 4: line plot of sizes. Each display ~3in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_DISPLAYS at Part 1: instructions ask the child to find mode in different displays. Keywords name the visual elements.

parts.answer_key: Display 1 mode: apples. Display 2 mode: cats. Display 3 mode: hockey (or whichever tallest). Display 4 mode: most common size.

parts.student_instructions: Look at 2 special data sets. Identify NO MODE or TWO MODES.
parts.visual_layout: Two data sets shown in tally chart form: Set 1 with all categories tied; Set 2 with two categories tied higher than the third.

image_placeholders.description: 2 special data sets for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Set 1 (no mode): all categories tied at 3 each. Set 2 (bimodal): two categories tied at 4 each, one at 2.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_SPECIAL at Part 2: instructions ask the child to identify special cases. Keywords name the categories.

parts.answer_key: Set 1: NO MODE. Set 2: TWO MODES (whichever are tied).

parts.student_instructions: Make a data set with a clear mode. List 5 values.
parts.visual_layout: Five numbered writing lines for the child to list 5 data values, with a header that reads My data set.

image_placeholders.description: 5 numbered lines for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Above: 'My data set:'. 5 numbered lines below for writing values.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_LINES at Part 3: instructions ask the child to make a data set. Keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Any 5-value data set with a clear most-common value (e.g., 5,5,3,2,1 — mode 5).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a sentence about the mode.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Use Part 2 for formative — recognizing special cases.
